Build the binary table of metadata modalities

Source: R/prepare_upset.R
prepare_upset.Rd

Creates one column per modality of each metadata, filled with 1 when the strain has this modality and 0 otherwise. The result can be used to draw an UpSet plot (e.g. with UpSetR::upset()) and to define profiles with define_profiles().

Usage

prepare_upset(prepared_data)

Arguments

prepared_data

A data frame with one row per strain, as returned by prepare_input().

Value

A data frame with the same row names as prepared_data and one numeric (0/1) column per modality, named "<metadata> _ <modality>". Modalities appear in their order of first appearance.

See also

Other profile method: define_profiles(), select_profiles(), select_strains()

Examples

raw_data <- salmonella_strains
prepared_data <- prepare_input(raw_data, col_select = c("CONTEXTE", "MATRICE1", "REGION", "SECTEUR", "LIEUPVT"),
                               id = "IDENTIFIANT", date = "DATE_PRELEVEMENT")
#> no duplicate ID
#> selected metadata: CONTEXTE, MATRICE1, REGION, SECTEUR, LIEUPVT, ANNEE
upset_data <- prepare_upset(prepared_data)
upset_data[1:5, 1:4]
#>               CONTEXTE _ Surveillance CONTEXTE _ Alerte Produit
#> 2020LSAL00151                       1                         0
#> 2020LSAL00152                       1                         0
#> 2020LSAL00163                       1                         0
#> 2020LSAL00167                       1                         0
#> 2020LSAL00176                       1                         0
#>               CONTEXTE _ Programmes de contrôle et d'éradication
#> 2020LSAL00151                                                  0
#> 2020LSAL00152                                                  0
#> 2020LSAL00163                                                  0
#> 2020LSAL00167                                                  0
#> 2020LSAL00176                                                  0
